method: controlled A/B: same commit (e0d860a), same worker (wrangler dev :8787), same simulated RTT 150ms; variant A built with prefetchPage() disabled, variant B = HEAD build. 5 cold runs per page, median reported. Static servers via tools/serve-dist.mjs on :4175 (A) and :4176 (B).
